title: [main] Feature 640068 - Separate settings for automatic dimensions
summary: A new settings table and page enable separate management of automatic dimension creation configuration, introducing a "Do Not Create Default Dimension" option and decoupling this feature from the Default Dimension table.
key_points: New AutoCreateDefaultDimCZA table stores automatic dimension creation settings independently
New page provides dedicated UI for managing automatic dimension creation configuration
Adds "Do Not Create Default Dimension" option to control when dimensions are created
DimensionAutoCreateMgtCZA refactored to use new table and mark old methods obsolete
Dimension auto-creation logic now conditional based on new setting
quote: New feature introducing a dedicated settings table for automatic dimension creation, separating configuration from the existing Default Dimension table.
